It does not support glob patterns: a list containing only "*" captures all context data attributes, and otherwise every entry, including one containing "*" or "?", is matched as a literal context data key. It is ignored when an included or excluded pattern is configured, and it may be removed in the next minor release.

configurations.description: Comma-separated list of case-sensitive glob patterns for MapMessage keys not to capture as log attributes. "*" matches any number of characters and "?" matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. No MapMessage attributes are captured unless an included pattern, an excluded pattern, or the deprecated otel.instrumentation.log4j-appender.experimental.capture-map-message-attributes setting is configured; configuring only excluded patterns captures all MapMessage attributes that do not match them. Captured MapMessage attributes may contain sensitive information.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.log4j-appender.experimental.map-message-attributes.excluded
